name.ja: Figure-riseLABO ホシノ・フミナ[The Second Scene]

description.ja: Figure-riseLABO 第一弾の「ホシノ・フミナ」が成形技術のさらなる向上により改良されて登場！
description.en: Figure-riseLABO's first model, "Hoshino Fumina", has been improved with further improvements in molding technology and is now available!

description.ja: • レイヤードの研究進化により、肌の赤みや陰影の美しいグラデーションを成形色の厚みによる透け具合で再現。
description.en: • Research and evolution of layering has reproduced the beautiful gradation of skin redness and shading through the transparency of the molded color.

description.ja: • 切り取ったゲート跡が目立たないよう全体的にゲートの接点を細かく加工。
description.en: • The contact points of the gate are finely processed throughout so that the cut gate marks are not noticeable.

description.ja: • 脇腹のゲートは組み立て後に跡が見えない位置に移動。
description.en: • The side gate has been moved to a position where no trace can be seen after assembly.

description.ja: • 水着は成形色をスポーティなダークブルーに変更。エナメルのような光沢ある成形表現により、よりリアルな質感を追求。
description.en: • The molding color of the swimsuit has been changed to a sporty dark blue. Pursuing a more realistic texture with a glossy enamel-like molding expression.

description.ja: • 揺れる水面と水しぶきをリアルに再現したクリアの専用台座と、砂浜をイメージした台紙が付属。
description.en: • Comes with a special clear pedestal that realistically reproduces the swaying water surface and splashing water, and a mount that resembles a sandy beach.
